quotes.card: HD 49674 is a solar-type star with an exoplanetary companion in the northern constellation of Auriga.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent visual magnitude of 8.10 and thus is an eighth-magnitude star that is too faint to be readily visible to the naked eye.
